verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official GitLab MCP server documented under GitLab Duo, and GitLab Orbit docs say it exposes MCP tools that any MCP-compatible agent can use. The AI governance docs describe Allow/Ask/Deny tool policies enforced for all connecting clients. missing for 10: detailed evidence of MCP server setup, auth and the exposed tool scope, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
